name: Exp_XFisher_org_v1
summary: This EA is based on the XFisher_org_v1 indicator, a Fisher Transform variant that maps price data into a Gaussian normal distribution to identify momentum reversals. It generates buy signals when the Fisher value crosses above its signal line from oversold territory and sell signals when it crosses below from overbought territory. The EA automates trade entry and exit based on these crossover signals with configurable lot sizing and stop loss parameters.
summary_zh: 该EA基于XFisher_org_v1指标，这是Fisher Transform的一个变体，将价格数据映射为高斯正态分布以识别动量反转。当Fisher值从超卖区域上穿信号线时产生买入信号，从超买区域下穿信号线时产生卖出信号。EA根据这些交叉信号自动执行入场和出场操作，并支持可配置的手数和止损参数。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用Fisher Transform的数学变换特性，将非正态分布的价格序列转换为近似正态分布，从而更清晰地识别价格动量的转折点。入场条件为：当Fisher指标线从负值区域（超卖）上穿其信号线时开多单，从正值区域（超买）下穿信号线时开空单。出场条件依赖反向交叉信号或预设止损止盈水平，部分实现可能包含跟踪止损机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户可通过参数设定交易量。资金管理方面缺乏基于账户余额的动态仓位调整机制，风险控制主要依赖止损参数。整体策略属于动量反转类型，在震荡行情中表现较好，但在强趋势行情中可能频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy leverages the mathematical transformation property of the Fisher Transform, converting non-normally distributed price series into an approximately Gaussian distribution to more clearly identify momentum turning points. Entry conditions are: open a long position when the Fisher line crosses above its signal line from negative territory (oversold), and open a short position when it crosses below from positive territory (overbought). Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals or preset stop loss and take profit levels, with some implementations potentially including a trailing stop mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user sets the trade volume through a parameter. Money management lacks dynamic position sizing based on account equity, and risk control primarily depends on stop loss parameters. The overall strategy falls under the momentum reversal category, performing better in ranging markets but potentially generating frequent false signals during strong trending conditions that can lead to consecutive losses.

pros: Fisher Transform具有良好的统计学基础，能有效平滑价格噪音并突出动量转折点
策略逻辑清晰简洁，信号明确基于指标交叉，易于理解和验证
参数较少，减少了过拟合的风险，便于参数优化和实盘调优
pros_en: The Fisher Transform has a solid statistical foundation, effectively smoothing price noise and highlighting momentum reversal points
The strategy logic is clear and concise with explicit crossover signals, making it easy to understand and verify
Fewer parameters reduce the risk of overfitting and facilitate optimization and live trading tuning
cons: 在强趋势行情中容易产生频繁的虚假反转信号，导致连续止损
缺乏动态仓位管理机制，固定手数无法根据市场波动性自适应调整
没有包含点差过滤和交易时段过滤，可能在流动性差或点差过大时产生不利成交
cons_en: Prone to generating frequent false reversal signals during strong trending markets, leading to consecutive stop losses
Lacks dynamic position sizing mechanism, as fixed lots cannot adapt to changing market volatility
Does not include spread filter or trading session filter, potentially resulting in unfavorable fills during low liquidity or high spread conditions
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损和仓位管理，根据市场波动性自动调整风险敞口
添加趋势过滤机制（如更高时间周期的均线方向），避免在强趋势中逆势交易
加入点差过滤和交易时段控制，提高成交质量和减少滑点损失
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and position sizing to automatically adjust risk exposure based on market volatility
Implement a trend filter mechanism (e.g., higher timeframe moving average direction) to avoid counter-trend trades during strong trends
Incorporate spread filter and trading session controls to improve fill quality and reduce slippage losses

risk_points: 固定手数缺乏资金管理，在小账户中可能导致单笔风险过大
Fisher Transform在趋势行情中信号频繁翻转可能造成连续亏损
缺少点差和流动性过滤可能在不利条件下成交
risk_points_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks money management, potentially causing excessive per-trade risk on small accounts
Fisher Transform signal whipsaws during trending markets can cause consecutive losses
Absence of spread and liquidity filters may result in unfavorable execution conditions
